name: ricochet-admin
description: Install, configure, and run a Ricochet server, including sign-in, execution backends, databases, monitoring, and licensing.

interface.shortDescription: Install and run a Ricochet server
interface.longDescription: Install Ricochet on a Linux host, in Docker, or on Kubernetes. Configure OIDC or SAML sign-in, execution backends, Postgres, package repositories, retention, logs, metrics, tracing, audit logs, users, and licenses.
